nodes.title: Notes
widgets_values:
## ⓪ Asset Browser — assets + project management
**Assets tab**: Categories | Assets | Viewer. `+ Add`, preview, edit name / category / tags, set audio/video range (in/out), **Replace** (swap the file, keep the ID), **Delete** (press twice to confirm).
**Projects tab**: Projects | Project contents (alias / order) | Library (click to add) → **Save / New project / Delete**.
Outputs: `asset_id` (selected asset), **`project_id` (selected project)** → wired to `project_id` of ② project mode.

nodes.title: Notes
widgets_values:
## ① Register
Copies images / image sets / audio / video into the library. The same file is never stored twice and returns the same ID. The box under each node shows `new #ID` / `existing #ID`.
- `alias` = the name used in prompts, e.g. `@hero`
- `as_set` = (shown only when an image is connected) bundles several images into one set
Group registered assets into a project on the **Projects tab** of ⓪.

nodes.title: Notes
widgets_values:
## ② MiniMax H3 Reference to Video - project mode
`mode = project`: **all** assets of the project are loaded at once. The project comes from the `project_id` output of the ⓪ Asset Browser (when connected it takes priority over the combo). The node's **Load / Refresh library** button fills the info box with asset IDs, aliases, final labels, limits and the match check. Type `@` in the prompt to get the asset list.
Drag the bar below the prompt box and the info box to resize each one.
**compress_refs**: off = best quality; on = reference tokens ¼, faster, less detail.
Output video: `C:\AI\output\TJ_RefLib\project_mode`

nodes.title: Notes
widgets_values:
## ③ MiniMax H3 Reference to Video - assets mode (default: Muted)
`mode = assets`: combos open one at a time (pick `asset_1` and `asset_2` appears); choose assets from the library. In the prompt, call them by number (`@1`) or by library name (`@Hero`).
**To enable:** Ctrl+drag to select the group → Ctrl+M. Mute ② and enable ③ to compare. Output video: `C:\AI\output\TJ_RefLibssets_mode`

nodes.title: Notes
widgets_values:
## ④ MiniMax H3 Image to Video (default: Muted)
Give the first / last frame as a **connected image** or a **library asset combo** (`first_asset`, `last_asset`); a connected image takes priority. The selected asset's thumbnail is shown on the node. The fl2va model and the 8-step LoRA are loaded separately.
**To enable:** Ctrl+drag to select the group → Ctrl+M. Output video: `C:\AI\output\TJ_RefLib\image_to_video`
